jd_text:
Om rollen
Rollen är en unik möjlighet att leda och vidareutveckla Capgemini Invents försvarsaffär i Sverige, med särskilt fokus på Försvarsmakten, FMV och andra försvarsmyndigheter. Du kommer att spela en central roll i att stödja det svenska försvarets pågående förmågetillväxt genom strategisk rådgivning, transformation och innovation. Du blir en central partner till våra kunder inom försvarssektorn och driver kritiska initiativ som bidrar till att stärka svensk försvarsförmåga. Uppdraget innebär att du sätter dig in i kundernas verksamhet och behov, identifierar möjligheter och utformar lösningar med stöd av Capgemini Groups starka globala kapacitet inom rådgivning, försvarskunnande, teknologi, data och AI. Du har ett övergripande ansvar utveckla kundrelationen, identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter och säkerställa långsiktigt och lönsamt samarbete med våra nyckelkunder inom försvarssegmentet. Genom att stärka partnerskapen och skapa tydliga, mätbara resultat bidrar du direkt till våra kunders framgång och till ett starkare och säkrare Sverige. Detta är ett av våra mest prioriterade områden och rollen har därför hög synlighet och stor strategisk betydelse.
Huvudsakliga ansvarsområden
- Bygga och utveckla strategiska kundrelationer inom försvarssektorn.
- Fördjupa dig i försvarsmyndigheternas uppdrag, förutsättningar och behov samt förstå hur Capgemini Invent bäst kan bidra till att skapa verklig effekt och stärkt svensk försvarsförmåga.
- Fungera som betrodd rådgivare till tjänstemän, chefer och ledande beslutsfattare samt utmana och vägleda deras strategiska riktning.
- Driva kommersiell tillväxt och utveckla försvarssegmentet långsiktigt.
- Leda affärsutveckling, från att identifiera nya möjligheter till att forma erbjudanden och vinna strategiska uppdrag.
- Expandera och utveckla försvarskonton samt bygga långsiktiga partnerskap med fokus på konkreta och mätbara resultat.
- Designa och leda transformationsprogram inom områden som verksamhetsutveckling, digitalisering, data och analys, AI samt större förmågehöjande initiativ.
- Samarbeta med tvärfunktionella experter och leveransteam inom Capgemini Group för att erbjuda integrerade och innovativa lösningar.
- Bidra till, samarbeta med och dra nytta av Capgeminis internationella försvarsexpertis genom Defense Europe.
- Bidra till att forma framtidens försvarsförmåga genom att driva dialogen kring områden som digital suveränitet, AI, cyberförsvar, interoperabilitet, data och försörjningsberedskap.
- Representera Capgemini Invent i försvars- och myndighetsekosystemet genom ledningsdialoger, konferenser, seminarier och branschforum.
- Leda, coacha och utveckla konsulter på alla nivåer.
- Främja en inkluderande, samarbetsinriktad och innovativ kultur inom Capgemini Invent.
Din profil
Du är en erfaren ledare med stark bakgrund inom offentlig sektor, försvarssektorn eller närliggande områden samt lång erfarenhet av konsultverksamhet och komplexa transformationer. Vi söker dig som har:
- Omfattande erfarenhet från statlig verksamhet eller försvarsrelaterade organisationer med god förståelse för styrning, regelverk, ekonomistyrning och beslutsprocesser.
- Stark kommersiell drivkraft och dokumenterat resultat inom affärsutveckling, kundansvar och långsiktig tillväxt.
- Etablerat nätverk och dokumenterad erfarenhet av att navigera komplexa beslutsmiljöer inom försvars- eller statlig sektor.
- Tryggt ledarskap och mycket god kommunikationsförmåga, med förmåga att påverka och bygga förtroende på högsta nivå.
- Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda komplexa transformationsprogram, exempelvis inom digitalisering, datadriven verksamhetsutveckling, organisationsförändring eller större strategiska initiativ.
- Akademisk examen inom exempelvis ekonomi, statsvetenskap, samhällsvetenskap, teknik eller motsvarande. Officersutbildning eller erfarenhet från Försvarsmakten, FMV eller annan försvarsrelaterad verksamhet är också meriterande.
- Flytande svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
- För rollen krävs svenskt medborgarskap och möjlighet att genomgå samt godkännas i säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen.
Varför Capgemini Invent
Att bli en del av Capgemini Invent innebär att ansluta till en global gemenskap av innovatörer, strateger, teknologer och förändringsledare som formar framtidens samhälle. Vi erbjuder:
- Meningsfull påverkan: Leda transformationer för några av Sveriges viktigaste myndigheter och bidra till att stärka svensk försvarsförmåga.
- Innovation i stor skala: Arbeta med spjutspetskompetens inom AI, data, cybersäkerhet, digital suveränitet och framtidens försvarsförmågor.
- Karriärutveckling: Tillgång till världsledande utbildningar, ledarskapsprogram, mentorskap och globala karriärmöjligheter.
- En samarbetsdriven kultur: Arbeta tillsammans med några av marknadens främsta experter i en kultur som värdesätter samarbete, entreprenörskap och kontinuerligt lärande.
- Global räckvidd, lokal påverkan: Kombinera styrkan från ett globalt nätverk med möjligheten att göra verklig skillnad för svenska kunder och samhället i stort.
Ansökan
I linje med vår tillitsbaserade kultur erbjuder Capgemini Invent ett flexibelt arbetssätt. Rollen är baserad på vårt centralt belägna kontor i Stockholm, med resor till kund vid behov.
Befattning och ansvarsnivå baseras på en helhetsbedömning av din erfarenhet och kompetens.
Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av giltig ID-handling, och bakgrundskontroller kan komma att genomföras där så är relevant.
Om Capgemini 
Capgemini är en global partner inom affärs- och tekniktransformation som hjälper organisationer att påskynda övergången till en digital och hållbar värld, och samtidigt gör skillnad för företag och samhälle. Det är en ansvarsfull och mångsidig organisation med 423 400 medarbetare i över 50 länder. Med ett starkt arv som sträcker sig över 55 år tillbaka har Capgemini sina kunders förtroende att hjälpa dem frigöra värdet av teknik för att tillgodose hela deras affärsbehov. Capgemini levererar helhetslösningar som utnyttjar styrkan från strategi och design till teknik. Allt drivet av en marknadsledande kapacitet inom AI, generativ AI, moln och data, kombinerat med en djup branschexpertis och ett ekosystem av partners. År 2025 rapporterade Capgemini Group globala intäkter på 22,5 miljarder euro.

En tant que consultants en transformation digitale, nous combinons nos capacités stratégiques, créatives et scientifiques, en collaborant étroitement avec nos clients pour leur fournir des solutions de pointes. Rejoignez-nous pour conduire une transformation adaptée aux défis d'aujourd'hui et de demain.
Lieu : Paris ou Toulouse
Vos missions
L’entité Aerospace & Defense accompagne les grands acteurs de l’aéronautique, du spatial et de la défense dans leurs projets de transformation digitale, durable et opérationnelle. Nos équipes interviennent sur des problématiques variées telles que le ramp-up industriel, la continuité numérique, la conformité règlementaire, l’optimisation de processus industriel, la sustainability.
En tant que consultant junior, vous accompagnerez les équipes sur des problématiques de stratégie, d’organisation et d’efficacité opérationnelle.
Vos responsabilités au sein d'une équipe projet et au contact du client seront :
- de collecter et d’analyser des données, via la conduite d’entretiens ou l’animation d’ateliers de co-construction chez le client,
- de participer à la présentation à nos clients des recommandations stratégiques identifiées avec eux,
- et de vous investir dans la vie interne du cabinet (recrutement, formations ; exemples : développement de contenu sectoriel et technologiques, développement personnel, prise de parole en public etc..).
Votre profil
- Diplômé d'école d’ingénieur, de commerce ou d’université, avec un vif intérêt pour les problématiques de transformation des entreprises et d’innovation digitale ; 
- Appétence particulière pour l’aéronautique, le spatial ou la défense ;
- Maîtrise courante de l’anglais et du français, à l’écrit comme à l’oral ; 
- Curiosité intellectuelle marquée et forte capacité d’adaptation dans des environnements variés.
Quelques raisons de nous rejoindre
- Avantages groupe : bénéficiez d’un ensemble d’avantages tels que les primes de cooptation, tickets restaurant, ainsi que des activités sociales et culturelles variées proposées par le CSE. Des dispositifs d’accompagnement à la parentalité, comme le temps partiel à 90% pendant les vacances scolaires, sont également disponibles, ainsi que de nombreux autres avantages issus de nos accords collectifs.
- Qualité de vie au travail : profitez d’un équilibre entre vie professionnelle et personnelle, d’une possibilité de télétravailler (en France), ainsi que des dispositifs de santé et bien-être (ligne d'écoute, plateforme dédiée...).
- Environnement inclusif : rejoignez des réseaux engagés comme Women@Capgemini, Parents@Capgemini, OUTfront ou CapAbility, et évoluez dans un cadre certifié EDGE+ et reconnu par le Bloomberg Gender Equality Index.
- Happy Trainees : notre engagement envers les jeunes talents est reconnu dans le classement HappyTrainees, preuve que chez nous, les stagiaires et alternants ne viennent pas juste apprendre… ils viennent s’épanouir !
Nos engagements et priorités
Le groupe Capgemini encourage une culture inclusive au sein d’un cadre multiculturel et handi-accueillant. En nous rejoignant, vous intégrez un collectif qui valorise la diversité, développe le potentiel de ses talents, s’engage dans des initiatives solidaires avec ses partenaires et se mobilise pour réduire son impact environnemental sur l’ensemble de ses sites ainsi qu’auprès de ses clients.
Capgemini Invent est la marque d’innovation digitale, de design et de transformation du groupe Capgemini. Etablie dans plus de 30 studios et plus de 60 dans le monde, elle compte une équipe de plus de 12 500 experts en stratégie, data scientists, concepteurs de produits et d’expériences ou encore experts en marques et en technologie qui développent de nouveaux services digitaux, produits, expériences et modèles d’affaire pour une croissance durable.
Get The Future You Want* | www.capgemini.com/fr
*Capgemini, le futur que vous voulez

About the Job You're Considering
As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design, augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI.
Our Enterprise Transformation team is looking for consultants who are excited to help organizations deliver complex business and technology transformations. You will join our Transformation Management capability, helping clients establish governance, drive execution discipline, manage delivery risk, and realize business value across large-scale transformation programs.
The Transformation Management capability focuses on program governance, PMO leadership, integrated planning, dependency management, value realization, and executive reporting. Our consultants help clients bring structure, transparency, and momentum to complex transformations while leveraging AI-enabled ways of working to improve decision-making and delivery outcomes.
 Your Role 
As a PMO Transformation Consultant, you will support complex transformation programs by applying structured program management practices, governance disciplines, and analytical problem-solving skills. You will work closely with client leaders, transformation offices, and delivery teams to drive execution and visibility across multiple workstreams.
You will:
- Support enterprise transformation programs through governance, coordination, and execution management
- Maintain integrated plans, milestones, dependencies, and critical path activities across workstreams
- Manage RAID logs and facilitate risk, issue, dependency, and decision management processes
- Develop executive-ready dashboards, status reports, and Steering Committee materials
- Support Transformation Management Office (TMO) and PMO functions, including governance and performance reporting
- Coordinate activities across business and technology teams to ensure alignment and accountability
- Analyze program performance metrics, delivery health indicators, and transformation outcomes
- Support value realization tracking, KPI monitoring, and benefits management initiatives
- Facilitate meetings, workshops, and governance forums while documenting actions and decisions.
- Leverage AI-enabled tools to improve reporting, analysis, and program coordination
Your Skills + Experience
You bring strong AI literacy, including familiarity with generative AI tools and an understanding of how AI can improve business and transformation outcomes. You are comfortable working in AI-augmented ways to enhance analysis, reporting, and collaboration while understanding responsible AI principles related to ethics, security, governance, and privacy.
Required Experience
- 2-5 years of consulting, PMO, TMO, program management, or transformation experience
- Experience supporting large-scale business or technology transformation initiatives
- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
- Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint capabilities
- Experience preparing executive communications and leadership reporting
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Comfortable working across cross-functional teams and leadership groups
Preferred Experience
- Consulting experience within a professional services environment
- Experience supporting ERP, digital, operating model, or technology transformation programs
- Exposure to governance design, portfolio management, agile delivery, or value realization
- Familiarity with program and project management methodologies

jd_text: You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients. You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking. THE WORK Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate: Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states. Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context. Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools. Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives. Client Engagement & Advisory Support Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions. Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders. Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams. Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples. Data & AI Foundations Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems. Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations. Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows. Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

jd_text: This role is for Accenture Research global Chemical and Natural Resources (CNR) Research team. The CNR Research Senior Analyst will support senior researchers and Accenture’s CNR industry leaders on both Thought Leadership reports / industry PoVs, as well as client research projects globally. This role's primary focus area will be chemicals, with natural resources (including metals, mining and forest products) being the secondary focus area. Knowledge on hot topics such circular systems, digitalization, advanced materials, energy transition is a must. A basic understanding of the oil/gas/refining industries/ metals and mining, as well as downstream industries will also be important for this role. Developing research insights and compelling business narratives alongside research leads. Presenting key findings in a structured and concise manner (with focus on insights). jd_text:
What makes Gartner Consulting a GREAT fit for you?




Gartner Consulting is an extension of Gartner’s world-renowned Research. We partner directly with CxOs across industry and government, helping organisations make smarter and faster decisions to achieve their mission-critical priorities.

Our Consulting team is made up of strategists, innovators, consultants, digital experts, former practitioners, and technologists, delivering 2,100+ strategic consulting engagements annually. We deliver unbiased and independent solutions, helping change conventional thinking and accomplish ground-breaking results for our clients.

We are a diverse team of strategic thought leaders. As we continue to grow we look for great people to join us on that journey, and grow with us.




About Role:

Gartner Consulting is looking for an Associate Consultant who will work with some of the world’s largest enterprises on their mission-critical priorities. The Associate Consultant will support consulting teams through structured research, quantitative and qualitative analysis, development of insights, and creation of high-quality client deliverables across digital strategy, technology strategy, operating model and enterprise transformation engagements.




What you’ll do:



Work as a collaborative member of consulting teams serving some of the world’s largest enterprises, supporting engagements focused on digital strategy, technology strategy, operating model, enterprise transformation and other mission-critical priorities.
Develop broad consulting experience across industries and practice areas, while building foundational capabilities in research, analytics, problem solving, client communication and engagement delivery.
Develop an understanding of client objectives, industry context and potential obstacles; structure assigned work to support engagement priorities and client deliverables.
Execute primary research and information-gathering activities, including collecting, organizing and validating client data, conducting market research and using Gartner research and benchmarks.
Perform clearly structured quantitative, qualitative and technical analyses with guidance, applying relevant Gartner methodologies, frameworks and best practices.
Test hypotheses using available evidence, identify patterns and anomalies, and translate research and analysis into straightforward insights, conclusions and recommendations with guidance.
Summarize analyses and observations for specific client deliverables or broader teamwork, clearly distinguishing facts, assumptions and areas requiring further validation.
Prepare high-quality client outputs, including executive presentations, assessment findings, workshop materials, roadmaps, business cases and written recommendations, using clear storylines and effective data visualization.
Participate in client interviews, workshops and working sessions; listen actively, ask relevant clarifying questions, document requirements and decisions, and support agreed follow-up actions.
Manage and prioritize assigned activities effectively, deliver work products within agreed timelines, and proactively communicate progress, dependencies, issues and risks to the engagement team.
Take ownership of the accuracy and quality of facts, data and analyses presented; conduct self and peer review, flag anomalies or concerns, and incorporate feedback before work is shared.
Invest in self-development, seek and apply coaching, participate in Gartner learning communities, and contribute to internal knowledge and intellectual capital development when requested.

 

What you’ll need:



2–4 years of professional experience in consulting, strategy, research, technology, business transformation or a related field. At least 2 years of Technology strategy consulting experience is highly preferred.
Demonstrated ability to gather, organize and analyze qualitative and quantitative information and convert it into clear observations or insights.
Strong structured problem-solving skills, including the ability to break down ambiguous questions, test hypotheses, apply strategy consulting frameworks and draw evidence-based conclusions with guidance.
Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate general and technical messages clearly and in plain language.
Experience developing high-quality presentations, analytical outputs or written deliverables, with strong attention to accuracy, consistency and detail.
Curiosity about business and technology trends and an interest in how digital, data, cloud, automation and emerging technologies can improve business outcomes.
Working knowledge of Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel; familiarity with data analysis, visualization, research or AI-enabled productivity tools is an advantage.
Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills, including the ability to work effectively with globally distributed and cross-border teams.
A curious and inquisitive mindset, openness to feedback and new experiences, and the ability to learn quickly and work effectively in ambiguous environments.
Bachelor’s degree required in engineering, technology, computer science, mathematics, statistics or a related discipline; an advanced degree in management is preferred.



Who you are:



Self-starter and quick learner who takes ownership of assigned work and demonstrates intellectual curiosity and a commitment to client impact.
Analytical thinker who approaches problems logically, asks relevant questions and uses evidence to develop sound conclusions.
Clear communicator who can synthesize complex information into concise, audience-appropriate messages and high-quality deliverables.
Collaborative team member who builds effective working relationships, responds well to coaching and actively incorporates feedback.
Organized and dependable, with the ability to manage priorities, meet agreed timelines and proactively raise issues or concerns.
Client-focused professional who listens actively, understands how assigned work connects to client objectives and takes responsibility for accuracy and quality.
Committed to continuous learning, including developing awareness of Gartner methodologies, consulting best practices, business trends and the responsible use of approved AI-enabled productivity tools.



What Gartner Consulting will offer you?



A world-class consulting environment.
The opportunity to work on high-impact digital, technology strategy and enterprise transformation engagements with a tier one client portfolio.
A competitive salary.
Structured bonus based on individual and corporate performance.
Opportunities for promotion with a clearly defined career development structure.
Opportunity to participate actively in the development and future of Gartner Consulting.
A dynamic but relaxed and supportive working environment that encourages personal development.

Your new role
Ramboll is seeking a highly motivated Environmental, Health and Safety Consultant to join the firm! We invite you to bring your strong analytical abilities into play as you evaluate regulatory compliance risks, contamination and other environmental, health and safety issues.
Your key responsibilities will be:
- Completing environmental site assessments of industrial and commercial sites and conducting due diligence reviews of multi-site portfolios for attorneys, lenders, developers, and industrial clients.
- Completing and managing limited environmental compliance reviews of industrial sites by reviewing and abstracting regulatory requirements for multi-media environmental compliance.
- Preparing, assembling, and submitting federal and state environmental permit applications, including air emissions, wastewater discharge, hazardous waste registration, and land use/impact permits, along with required technical attachments and application fees.
- Supporting the preparation of environmental impact studies, including sections and technical appendices, under Mexican regulatory frameworks, and supporting projects in achieving conformance and compliance with international sustainability standards.
- Approximately 40% travel, mainly within Mexico.
About You
- Bachelor's degree in Environmental, Chemical Engineering or Sciences, Sustainability, Mechanical or Civil Engineering or other related Engineering, Environmental Science, or Geology field with related consulting experience. Masters’ degree in related field is a plus and 
- 3+ years of related EHS experience. 
- Must be bilingual in English and Spanish. A valid driver's license and passport required.
What we can offer you
- Investment in your development
- Being valued for the unique person you are
- Never being short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
- The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company
Ready to join us?
Please submit your application with your up-to-date CV in English. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.
Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.
Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas
Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.
Where People Flourish

Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. Transport, Mobility & Infrastructure Sector
About Arup
Arup is a global collective of designers, engineers, consultants and technical specialists working together to create a more sustainable future.
Our team in Spain is growing its strategy and transformation consulting capability to support public and private sector clients in addressing complex challenges across mobility, infrastructure and public services.
We are looking for an experienced consultant to play a key role in delivering high-impact advisory projects, leading workstreams, supporting clients through strategic decision-making and helping shape the growth of our consulting business.
The Opportunity
This role is ideal for someone with a background in management consulting, strategy, transformation or programme advisory who enjoys solving complex problems, working across disciplines and translating analysis into actionable recommendations.
The successful candidate will work on complex consulting assignments for transport operators, mobility providers, infrastructure owners, public authorities and government agencies. Projects typically involve strategic planning, business case development, organisational and operational transformation, programme governance, investment decision-making and implementation planning.
This is a hands-on consulting role. We are looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with a strong delivery mindset and is comfortable moving between executive discussions and detailed project execution.

Strategy & Transformation
· Support clients (transport/mobility sector) in addressing strategic, operational and organisational challenges.

· Translate complex challenges into structured recommendations and actionable programmes.
Business Cases & Investment Decisions
· Develop business cases and option assessments for major programmes and initiatives.
· Evaluate strategic, operational and delivery implications of investment decisions.
· Support the prioritisation, sequencing and definition of transformation programmes.
· Integrate technical, operational and commercial considerations into decision-making frameworks.
Project Delivery
· Lead consulting workstreams with a high degree of autonomy.
· Coordinate inputs from multidisciplinary teams across different technical disciplines.
· Manage project planning, quality assurance and stakeholder engagement activities.
· Support the delivery of high-quality reports, presentations and client-facing outputs.
Team & Business Growth
- Coach and mentor junior consultants.
- Review and oversee analytical work and deliverables.
- Support proposal development and business development activities.

jd_text:
Joining Arup
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.
Arup is an independent firm of designers, planners, engineers, consultants and technical specialists offering a broad range of professional services. Through our work, we make a positive difference in the world.
Arup's innovative approach to environmental & sustainability consulting enables clients to achieve their sustainable business and corporate responsibility aspirations. We advise at each stage of a project or business development. Arup offers a multidisciplinary service aimed at developing policy, assessing impact, creative design and implementation, gaining regulatory approvals, reporting publicly, managing risk and controlling costs.
The Opportunity
We are seeking an energetic and enthusiastic Senior Sustainability Consultant with design and/or construction delivery project knowledge. The role involves preparing and delivering sustainability strategies and identifying and managing the implementation of environmental and sustainability measures in projects during design, procurement, construction and/or operation stages.
The position is for a Senior Consultant to work within our Environment, Climate and Sustainability Services portfolio in London. You will promote and manage a range of projects in the areas of environmental / sustainability advice on significant design and construction projects. Activities will include guiding strategic sustainability advice including leading sustainability strategies, frameworks and appraisals, and auditing of design / construction contractors, ISO 14001, consultation with statutory authorities. The clients will include major infrastructure schemes and private developers. You will be working in a multi-disciplinary environment alongside other environmental, planning, engineering and urban design specialists.
Your remit will be to undertake and manage the production of technical work, co-ordinate with specialists and multi-disciplinary project teams, be accountable for quality and budget control, and assist with proposal preparation and marketing activities.
Work as the environmental sustainability representative in project delivery teams to drive and embed aspects of sustainability into major infrastructure and planning projects.
Develop comprehensive environmental and sustainability strategies and recommendations to project delivery teams and Clients.
Manage and prepare environmental and sustainability deliverables, coordinating with virtual teams of topic specialists as necessary.
Prepare and deliver presentations, workshops and/or training to teams and clients. Assist with managing projects including preparing and tracking budgets, resources and programmes
At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share, and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.
You will have the opportunity do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.
Is this role right for you?
We are looking for people with the following skills –
· Bachelor’s or Master’s university degree in a relevant field such as Sustainability, Climate Change, Environmental Engineering/Management or Geography. We would prefer qualifications which demonstrate multi-disciplinary and strategic problem solving. Other relevant qualifications will be considered. 
· Practitioner or Full Member of the Institute of Sustainability and Environmental Professionals (ISEP) or equivalent.
· Chartered or working towards Chartered Environmentalist.
· ISEP Registered Environmental Auditor would be an advantage.
· Qualified or desire to become a qualified BREEAM Infrastructure Project Assessor.
· Knowledge in delivering environmental sustainability aspects of strategy, design and construction major infrastructure or master planning projects.
· Appreciation of the principles of environmental sustainability and its relationship to the planning, design and operation of the built environment, including legislation in the UK and Environmental Impact Assessment in a planning context. Writing, editing and reviewing technical and non-technical reports relating to environment and sustainability topics.
· Awareness of PAS2080 carbon management in infrastructure or similar.
Not ready to apply just yet, or have some questions? Please email Lei Padua at Lei.Padua@arup.com. Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.
What we offer you
At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.
Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognizes the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.
We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.
We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.
Different People, Shared Values
Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.
Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup.
We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact Lei Padua at Lei.Padua@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.
Our Application Process
To understand what to expect next, please visit: https://www.arup.com/careers/recruitment-process/
Stay safe online – Arup will never ask for your bank details as part of our recruitment process.
Recruitment Agencies – We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.
Closing date: 15 November 2026

Consultant - Business & Investor Advisory
Shape a future with purpose at Arup in Milan
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future.  
The Opportunity
The BIA team provides technical, commercial and strategic advice to financial investors, infrastructure operators, developers, public sector clients and international financial institutions across the infrastructure sector.
The successful candidate will support the delivery of a wide range of projects within the transport, telecommunications and social infrastructure sectors. Typical assignments include technical and commercial due diligence, asset reviews and strategic advisory services supporting investment, acquisition, financing and development decisions.
Working as part of multidisciplinary teams, you will contribute to the assessment of technical, operational, commercial and ESG aspects of infrastructure projects and portfolios, helping clients understand risks, opportunities and key value drivers.
The role offers an excellent opportunity to develop both technical and commercial skills while working alongside experienced advisors on high-profile infrastructure transactions and projects.
As Consultant at Arup, you will:
- Contribute to technical, commercial, and ESG due diligence assignments, supporting clients in evaluating projects and investment opportunities
- Research and analyse project information, reviewing data and documentation to identify key risks, opportunities, and investment considerations
- Prepare clear, high-quality client deliverables, including due diligence reports, presentations, and decision-making materials
- Engage with clients and project stakeholders through meetings, workshops, and site visits, contributing insights throughout the assignment
- Support business and team development by contributing to proposals, market research, sector knowledge, and continuous improvement initiatives
Does this role inspire you?
We're looking for someone who enjoys working with clients and multidisciplinary teams on diverse projects. We also value:
- Degree-qualified in Engineering or another relevant technical or infrastructure-related discipline
- 3–6 years’ professional experience in infrastructure advisory, consulting, project delivery, or technical and commercial due diligence
- Experience in at least one relevant infrastructure sector, such as transport, social infrastructure, telecommunications, digital infrastructure, or data centres
- Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to interpret complex technical and commercial information and translate findings into clear reports and presentations
- Fluent in Italian and English, with good knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and the confidence to work effectively in multidisciplinary and client-facing teams
Why Arup?
At Arup, we believe in rewarding our members for their contributions to our shared success. As a trust-owned company, we have the freedom to pursue meaningful work that aligns with our purpose and values. We also offer a unique profit share program, allowing our members to share in the results of our collective efforts.
Benefits that work for you:
- Professional Growth & Development: Benefit from continuous learning opportunities, training programs, and mentorship to enhance your skills and advance your career at Arup.
- Global Opportunities: Collaborate with colleagues worldwide and explore potential short-term or long-term assignments at other Arup offices and project locations.
- Financial Well-being & Ownership: Receive a competitive salary and benefits package and share in Arup's success through our global profit-sharing programme.
- Flexible working: Working from home up to 3 days a week and up to 20 days a year from another country.
In Italy, the gross annual salary (RAL) for this role is €45,000 to €52,550, in accordance with the applicable provisions of the CCNL Terziario (Confcommercio). The final salary is determined using objective and gender-neutral criteria, reflecting experience, qualifications and role-relevant skills.
At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective where individuality is encouraged. Our strength comes from how we respect, share, and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas. You'll have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, and to the clients and communities we serve.
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of the world around us. We actively promote a culture of inclusion where everyone feels welcome, respected, and valued.
We welcome applications from talented individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, disability, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible. If you need any assistance or adjustments, please visit our Candidate Support page for contact information and assistance. We're happy to help.

jd_text:
Joining Arup
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. 
Our Economics and Casemaking practice sits within the Cities, Planning and Design (CPD) team and is at the forefront of thinking about the future of places. We work with clients to understand the economic, social and spatial value of places, helping them articulate compelling stories, build robust cases for investment, and deliver inclusive and sustainable growth.
Watch this short clip to discover how Arup are shaping a better world and how you could be a part of it!
The Opportunity
We are looking for a Consultant to join our Economics & Casemaking team in Leeds, part of a national practice working at the forefront of shaping cities and places.
You’ll support a wide range of projects across regeneration, economic development, infrastructure and growth, helping clients build compelling cases for investment, develop strategies for inclusive and sustainable growth, and deliver complex programmes. This includes contributing to business cases, strategy and vision documents, socio‑economic analysis, impact assessments and social value work.
Working as part of collaborative, multidisciplinary project teams, you’ll engage with public sector clients, developers and other stakeholders, providing clear, evidence‑based advice in dynamic and often long‑term environments. You’ll work closely with colleagues across Arup, including planners, designers, transport and sustainability specialists.
You don’t need experience in every area. We’re an inclusive team and welcome applicants with a strong interest in cities, regions and the built environment, who are keen to learn, grow and make a positive impact from day one.
At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective – in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas.
You will have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, to our members and to the clients and communities we serve.
Is this role right for you?
We’re looking for someone who is curious, motivated and enjoys working collaboratively. You’ll bring:
- A degree (or working towards one) in economics, geography, regeneration, real estate, public or social policy, business, town planning or a related built‑environment discipline
- Strong written communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to produce clear, engaging reports and presentations
- Confidence communicating verbally, including contributing to meetings, workshops and presentations
- Analytical and research skills, with the ability to interpret data and synthesise information
- A collaborative mindset and enthusiasm for working as part of a team
- Good organisational skills, with the ability to manage time and priorities effectively
- A genuine interest in the built environment, including urban regeneration, housing, transport, net zero and related current affairs
Experience with tools such as GIS, PowerBI, economic modelling or Better Business Case training is welcomed but not essential.
This role does not meet the criteria for visa sponsorship under the UK immigration system. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK. 
Not ready to apply just yet or have some questions? Contact Drina Zupanovic at Drina.Zupanovicgerard@arup.com - Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.
 What we offer you
At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.
Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.
We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.
We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.
Different people, shared values
Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.
Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup.
We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact Drina.Zupanovicgerard@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.
Our Application Process
To understand what to expect next, please visit https://www.arup.com/careers/recruitment-process/
Stay safe online – Arup will never ask for your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

Joining Arup
Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.
The water sector is undergoing unprecedented change. Climate risks, population growth, ageing infrastructure, environmental ambition and sector reform are creating some of the most complex challenges the industry has ever faced. Our clients are looking for new ways to plan, invest and adapt, and Arup is helping shape that future.
The Opportunity
We are looking for a junior consultant to join our dynamic and growing team, in one of our offices in Bristol, Cardiff and Birmingham, who is excited by the challenge of driving innovation, delivering excellence for our clients, influencing the sector both nationally and internationally through our projects and thought leadership, and working in collaborative, diverse teams. We combine policy, strategy, economics, engineering and asset management expertise to help clients make better long-term decisions. Our work influences national policy, investment decisions and operational strategies across the water sector.
The Mid-West Strategic Water Services team provides expertise in:
- Policy, regulation and governance;
- Strategy and planning, including long-term strategies, adaptive plans, water resources management plans (WRMP), drainage and wastewater management plans (DWMP) and flood risk management strategies;
- Asset management and investment planning
As part of our growing Strategic Water Services team, you will work with leading water companies, regulators, governments and investors to tackle nationally significant challenges and help create more resilient water systems for people and the environment.
You will help us to deliver effective and professional services for a range of varied and high-profile clients, such as Welsh Water, Wessex Water, Northern Ireland Water, Severn Trent Water, The Nature Conservancy, Ofwat, Natural Resources Wales and the Environment Agency. Working as part of a team, your role will be to advise city and infrastructure clients on a range of policy, regulatory, asset management and engineering issues. 
Across the public and private sectors, you will help manage client relationships with public sector agencies, private sector clients, infrastructure operators and other organisations such as regulators.
What you’ll do
Working collaboratively with colleagues across the UK and internationally, you will help deliver strategic advisory services for a range of clients in the water sector. You will contribute to research, analysis, client engagement and project delivery, helping to shape robust and forward-looking solutions.
Your responsibilities are likely to include:
- Shaping water sector strategy, policy and investment decisions.
- Supporting clients on climate resilience, water security and infrastructure challenges.
- Analysing data and evidence to develop strategic recommendations.
- Engaging water companies, regulators, governments and stakeholders.
- Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver integrated solutions.
- Supporting project delivery, business development and client relationships.
- Contributing to thought leadership and industry best practice.
- Developing expertise through training, mentoring and varied projects.

- Degree in Engineering, Economics, Geography, Environmental Science, Mathematics, Water Science, Public Policy, Asset Management or related field; Master's/PhD desirable.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving and strategic thinking skills. 
- Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement and relationship-building skills. 
- Ability to work across engineering, economics, policy, regulation and sustainability, with curiosity, initiative and strong organisation.

Join one of the fastest growing transaction advisory services practices in the country, where your talent and efforts are valued. Thrive in BDO’s entrepreneurial environment with an innovative and flat organizational structure. Be challenged based on your abilities and not your title. Be part of the number one middle market deals team and truly experience the opportunity of being an immediate contributor with real opportunities for career advancement. Work with industry leaders, technical experts and most importantly, people you enjoy spending time with. The Transaction Experienced Advisory Services Senior Associate will be responsible for managing financial, accounting and operational due diligence engagements for both strategic and financial buyers throughout the USA.

 - Prepares data book, reconciles company financial statements generates financial tables and analyses for due diligence report
 - Analyzes financial forecasts, historical earnings, assets and liabilities of target client
 - Performs industry and company research
 - Collects information from all available sources related to the target client’s business
 - Conducts on-site and / or phone interviews with C-level personnel or target client to gather additional information in support of the financial analysis
 - Identifies and proposes appropriate resolutions to critical issues related to the M&A process
 - Manages the relationship and information flow between BDO and the target client
 - Partners with Transactional Services Senior Manager and Principal/Director to identify and pursue business development opportunities 
 - Researches and develops proposal documents and may participate in presentations in pursuit of acquiring new clients
 - Other duties as required

Education:
 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, or Finance, required
 - MBA, preferred
Experience:
 - Four (4) or more years of public accounting experience, required
 - One (1) or more years of prior TAS experience, preferred
 - Prior experience interacting and working directly with C-level personnel, preferred
License/Certifications:
 - CPA, CPA candidate, or CA, preferred 
Software:
 - Proficient in using Microsoft Office Suites, specifically Word, Excel and PowerPoint – strong modeling skills, required
 - Prior exposure utilizing IDEA, preferred 
Language:
 - N/A
Other Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills, specifically business writing aptitude
 - Ability to interact with and adapt communication style to successfully convey messaging and objectives to all levels of management 
 - Capable of initiating and maintaining solid relationships with all levels of client personnel, as well as utilizing network and industry relationships to identify business development opportunities
 - Capable of working in a demanding, deadline-driven environment either independently or within a team dynamic while effectively managing unexpected issues and/or questions in a professional manner 
 - Ability to analyze large volumes of data to identify potential issues and propose the most appropriate resolutions to benefit the buyer 
 - Required to maintain the highly confidential nature of information
 - Excellent project management skills with ability to produce quality work project with an attention to detail
 - Knowledgeable of technical accounting areas such as US GAAP and SEC reporting
 - Knowledge of IFRS desirable
 - Ability to travel as needed

Description 
 About Alvarez & Marsal 
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The Team .
Our Performance Improvement team provides Business Transformation and Performance Improvement Services to Corporates, Investors, and their portfolio companies, delivering –
- Performance improvement via cost reduction and revenue growth programmes
- Large, complex organizational restructuring and business transformation
- Rapid Results Program, which helps to quickly and effectively assess business process management risks and identify key areas impeding performance
How you will contribute
As Senior Associate, you will be working closely with Directors, Senior Directors and Managing Directors in a flat team structure. You will likely lead key Commercial Due Diligence / Operational Due Diligence (CDD/ODD) work streams and benefit from constant exposure to the senior members of the team and client, and gain ‘on-the-job’ learning and development, leveraging on their substantial experience. You come with a proven track record in due diligence experience, consulting case experience, market research, IP development. This role involves hands-on analysis and development client ready output to drive strategic decision-making for our corporate and private equity clients. The ideal candidate will combine functional & technical expertise with strong individual contributor skills to deliver impactful solutions across various TDI domains
Considering the pace of targeted growth, we are keen to find people who are entrepreneurial, driven by a passion to drive significant growth (people who can think in multiples of growth rather than percentages), are comfortable with ambiguity, will roll up the sleeves and be hands on to get things done and can be independent requiring limited cover.
The role will be initially based in Gurgaon. However, the person should be open to travel as and when needed and should be open to relocate to any location our Capability Center scales and decide to relocate.
Key responsibilities:
Lead CDD/ODD delivery for Telecom & Digital Infrastructure (TDI) engagements
- Collaborate with clients and onshore case teams to gather and analyse business requirements, translating them into due diligence specifications and process improvements, especially within telecom and digital infrastructure contexts. You will focus onOwn and drive workstreams within
- Commercial Due Diligence (market sizing, competitive positioning, customer/churn analysis, growth thesis testing) and Operational Due Diligence (cost structure, network/ infrastructure efficiency, OSS/BSS maturity, organizational capability, synergy identification) for telecom and digital infrastructure targets
- Build and stress-test EBITDA bridges, cost benchmarks, and operational KPIs against sector peers to validate or challenge management's plan
- Identify and articulate red flags, deal risks, and value creation opportunities in a manner that is deal-timeline appropriate and client-ready
- Apply deep knowledge of TDI sub-sectors (Wireless, Wireline, B2B & B2C, ICT, Towers, Fiber, Cable, Data Centers) to sharpen diligence hypotheses and interpret data room material with sector context
- Support post-diligence value creation planning where engagements extend into implementation
- Supporting sales and proposal efforts by developing domain-specific expertise, thought leadership, and market perspective
- Own medium to complex work-streams with support from supervisors
- Work with different analytical tools with focus on building expertise in Power BI, Alteryx/ Python, Excel and PowerPoint
Own stakeholder relationships
- Own stakeholder relationships
- Interpret, understand and break-down client data/ requirements and project goals across various scenarios and adapt to them
- Communicate information/ insights, and the impact of the analyses to the clients and internal team
- Manage important work streams and own key business processes to solve client problems
- Participate & Lead meetings with senior clients, A&M Managing Directors, and third parties about your workstreams. Lead pitch preparation with senior staff and support business development and marketing efforts
Prioritization and Growing A&M
- Identifying project needs and milestones to manage & accomplish assigned work by agreed deadlines
- Collaborate with team members to create and deliver client outputs
- Contribute to office management roles (such as trainings, marketing, recruitments etc.) Qualifica
Qualifications 
- MBA graduate with 3-8 years of experience within a leading functional & strategy Consulting/ operational Consulting house is preferable
- Hands-on experience delivering CDD/ODD engagements preferably on US-based deals or for US clients
- Strong understanding of the Telecom & Digital Infrastructure industry across sub-sectors (such as Wireless, Wireline, Towers, Fiber, Data Centers, Managed Services, etc.), value chain, growth drivers, and how investors evaluate assets in the space
- Familiarity with the US telecom/digital infra competitive and regulatory landscape, including key players, consolidation trends, and the deal structures typical to the sector (carve-outs, infrastructure funds, platform build-ups, etc.)
- Track record of leading or co-leading diligence workstreams end-to-end: hypothesis design, data room navigation, management interviews, and synthesis into client-ready findings
- Technical Skills
o PowerPoint skills - preparation of defect-free, high-quality client presentations
o Excel modelling skills - structure data within Excel in a way to draw conclusions and support timely decision making with our clients
o Experience working in tools such as Alteryx or Python for data analysis, and Power BI or Tableau for data visualization is a strong plus
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, business acumen, writing, research and presentation-building skills; attention to detail and striving to produce defect free deliverables
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a global team environment
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks and priorities
- Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
- Guide/ mentor Analysts and Associates during projects and business development work
- A strong team player and demonstrated ability to motivate team members
- Ability to prioritize - especially in highly pressured situations
- High integrity that is characterized by the ability to deliver messages even when they are difficult to hear
- Ability to quickly understand and piece together very vast or very limited amounts of data and to draw certain conclusions/actions from it
Your journey at A&M 
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey.  Description 
 Alvarez & Marsal Private Equity Performance Improvement
Senior Associate, Supply Chain: Procurement & Sourcing
(OPEN TO ALL U.S. LOCATIONS)
About Alvarez & Marsal
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.
The Team
A&M’s Private Equity Performance Improvement Services (PEPI) practice, with offices throughout the US, focuses on serving the middle market and large cap private equity firms who have engaged A&M to help improve operating results at their portfolio companies. 
Our professionals are aligned with a PEPI service line to promote the development of deep functional skills & experiences and to maximize our ability to tailor solutions to solve our clients' business issues. 
Our PEPI services include:
Supply Chain
Transformation Services
Manufacturing Operations Improvement
Interim Management
M&A Services
CFO Services
A&M’s Supply Chain professionals assist our clients in analyzing each part of the supply chain process including Strategic Sourcing and Procurement, Logistics and Distribution, Integrated Demand and Supply Planning to identify value creation opportunities, develop a roadmap to accelerate those opportunities and assist with driving them to our client’s bottom line. From our thorough fact-based analysis, we assess the state of the supply chain, identify key risks to investment and quantify potential EBITDA improvement plans. 
The PEPI Supply Chain group is a growing business with high growth projected throughout the next two to four years. We offer excellent opportunities for career advancement and build leadership skills. The leadership team is focused on providing development opportunities, training and exposure to international and domestic business assignments.
How You Will Contribute 
We are seeking individuals that can lead and deliver project work streams for complex client engagements working closely with Private Equity teams to identify, design, and implement creative business solutions for their portfolio companies. 
Senior Associates support the following types of workstreams and may be asked to conduct analysis as well as execute with team members to deliver results:
- Gain a comprehensive understanding of a client’s procurement organization and strategic sourcing capabilities
- Assist in the development and implementation of sourcing strategies to meet growth and financial objectives through effective integration with forecasting, demand/supply planning, inventory management, and distribution & logistics
- Assist in developing and managing efforts in sourcing and procurement
- Lead supplier identification, approval, contract/pricing negotiations and vendor relations
- Develop implementation plans to drive proposed changes in procurement and sourcing initiatives
- Conduct analysis depending on project scope.
Professional skills:
- Strong written, oral, and analytical skills
- Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
- Structured project management (time, team and work-stream management)
- Initiative and drive
- Critical thinking skills
- Ability to deliver time-pressured projects on-time and on-quality
- Flexible and creative thinking
- Client relationship building
- Excellent presentation skills
Qualifications:
- 4-7 plus years of consulting or industry experience
- Previous advisory experience from a top-tier strategy firm or Big-4 consultancy REQUIRED
- Preference for industry roles within Sourcing and Procurement functions
- Industry experience in direct and/or indirect categories
- MBA preferred
- Experience managing direct and / or indirect categories
- Demonstrated track record of leading sustainable high-impact strategic sourcing approaches
- Exemplary experience designing end-to-end procurement strategies
- Excellent fact-gathering and analytical skills, including business process mapping and quantitative analysis
- Flexibility to travel up to 80% of the time
Your journey at A&M
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.
The salary range is $100,000--$170,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details.
Full-time Positions and Part-time Positions Over 30 hours
Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez & Marsal Holdings’ fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD&D, and disability coverages at rates determined from time to time as well as a 401(k) retirement plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive a discretionary contribution to their 401(k) from Alvarez & Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy-two (72) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click here for more information regarding A&M’s benefits programs.
Alvarez & Marsal recruits on an ongoing basis. Candidates are considered as they apply, until the opportunity is filled. Candidates are encouraged to apply expeditiously to any role(s) that they are qualified for and that are of interest to them.
A&M does not require or administer lie detector tests as a condition of employment or continued employment. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

We trust our people to take ownership early, contribute to meaningful challenges, and drive results that matter. We empower growth and champion diverse perspectives. Above all, we value doing the right thing. For those ready to roll up their sleeves, lead with integrity, and be difference makers, this is where it starts.
